set.body:
Scope
Provide an honest outer solver for nonconvex structured factorizations.

Acceptance criteria
- Admission records bounded-level-set/coercivity evidence, block convexity, Lipschitz bounds, exact or summably inexact subproblem policy, and KL/semi-algebraic applicability where claimed.
- Iterations enforce monotonicity or theorem-specific sufficient decrease.
- Full objective, block residual, normalization error, and stationarity traces are retained.
- SVD and deterministic multi-start policies preserve every start result and selection criterion.
- General results claim only critical/stationary or coordinatewise-stationary convergence.
- Special convexified/nuclear-norm global certificates are separately checked.
- Adversarial initialization, weak eigengap, singular geometry, and inexact-prox tests pass on JVM and JS.
